response.rationale: R1 best integrates the enhancing orbital roof mass with the expansile lytic bony lesion of the orbital walls, matching the chronic proptosis and vision loss. rejected.why: Only vision loss and a nonspecific enhancing mass are cited; no bony lesion or NF1 stigmata such as café-au-lait spots or sphenoid wing dysplasia.
The expansile lytic bony lesion is cited, but osteoma is a dense sclerotic lesion; the lytic description contradicts it and no soft-tissue mass is captured.
